versions.content: The E2E Transformer shall be able to detect the following development errors: Type of error Related error code Value [hex] Error code if any other API service, except GetVersionInfo is called before the transformer module was initialized with Init or after a call to DeInit E2EXF_E_UNINIT 0x01 Error code if an invalid configuration set was selected E2EXF_E_INIT_FAILED 0x02 API service called with wrong parameter E2EXF_E_PARAM 0x03 API service called with invalid pointer E2EXF_E_PARAM_POINTER 0x04
